Aapka paisa kitne saal mein double hoga? 72 se pata karo. ⏱️

Rule of 72: 72 / return % = saal
• PPF 7.1% (Oct-Dec 2026) → ~10 saal
• Equity 12% (maan ke, guaranteed nahi) → ~6 saal
• ₹1 lakh, 30 saal, 12% maan ke → ~₹30 lakh

Ulta bhi: 6% mehngai maan lo → 12 saal mein ₹100 ka saamaan ₹200 ka.

Save karo, har investment pe yeh check lagao. Aapka paisa kitne saal mein double ho raha hai? 👇
